funding.name: Ohio College Opportunity Grant (OCOG)
funding.provides: A state need-based grant for Ohio residents attending participating Ohio colleges, with awards based on FAFSA-derived need and enrollment status.
funding.eligibility: Ohio resident (per rule); need-based using FAFSA results; limited to ten full-time semesters of eligibility (per Cleveland State page).
funding.amount: 2025-2026 awards per Cleveland State page: $4,000 full-time, $3,000 three-quarter time, $2,000 half-time, $1,000 one-quarter time
funding.how_to_apply: Submit the FAFSA; application deadline October 1 each year (per Cleveland State page).
